jobs.description: Since our beginnings at Dr. Oetker, we have been breaking new ground. At Dr. Oetker, you can actively shape the future - both yours and ours. We want to be part of something bigger. Don't you?JOIN THE TASTE.YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES- You assume overall responsibility for the strategic direction, development and performance of international strategic and tactical procurement for indirect goods and services. As a member of the international procurement leadership team, you ensure the implementation of defined standards, value contributions and the overarching procurement strategy.- Your responsibilities include leading and developing the International Procurement Indirects organization. Together with international Commodity Managers and the wider Indirects team you establish high-performing collaboration, successful execution of impactful category strategies, clear accountabilities and a leadership culture aligned with Dr. Oetker's leadership principles.- You continuously advance the International Indirects agenda and deliver sustainable value through strategic demand management, standardization, bundling, digitalization and a forward-looking approach to supplier portfolio management.- Furthermore, you manage the performance of the assigned categories, create transparency regarding target achievement and value contribution and establish effective global standards, processes and governance mechanisms.- You lead strategic and complex international negotiations and ensure professional supplier relationship management, proactive risk management and effective escalation mechanisms.- In addition, you actively contribute to the further development of the International Procurement Indirects organization and its target operating model. In doing so, you establish clear roles, decision-making pathways, governance structures and harmonized ways of working.- You build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders on an international level.- As a strategic business partner, you advise international functions and senior management on investments, make-or-buy decisions, innovation initiatives and business-critical transformation programs.- You initiate and lead international and cross-functional projects, represent the procurement perspective in due diligence processes within M&A activities and act as the representative of International Procurement Indirects in relevant steering committees.WHAT YOU BRING- You hold a university degree and are a true procurement expert. You bring many years of international experience and deep expertise in strategic indirect procurement of goods and services and/or commodity management across key and complex indirect spend categories.- Ideally, you have a proven track record in leading and developing international teams and are experienced in managing complex matrix organizations. Even without direct disciplinary authority you are able to inspire and mobilize people to achieve shared objectives effectively.- You have a strong command of managing complex transformation and change initiatives within international organizations. You combine strategic foresight with strong business acumen and a results-oriented execution mindset.- You excel in stakeholder-focused communication at management and executive level, possess outstanding stakeholder management skills and handle conflicting priorities, complex negotiations and escalations with confidence.- You think strategically, analytically and solution-oriented, take ownership and constructively challenge existing processes and ways of working. Strong intercultural competence and a collaborative leadership style further distinguish you.- You have a solid understanding of digital procurement solutions, integrated Source-to-Contract and Procure-to-Pay processes as well as data-driven performance management models. Knowledge of SAP MM and BW, along with proficiency in Microsoft 365, would be an advantage.- You recognize the potential of Artificial Intelligence and data-driven solutions and leverage them purposefully to advance procurement, improve decision quality and enhance value creation.- Fluency in German and English, as well as a willingness to travel internationally, round off your profile.WHAT WE OFFER YOU- Attractive remuneration- Flexible work models & mobile work- 30 days of vacation plus Special vacation at Christmas & New Year's Eve- Onboarding and professional development opportunities- Excellent employee restaurant and discounts in the Dr. Oetker Shop- Events and celebrations- Sports, health and fitness offers- Pension plan, Sabbatical and JobRad- Employee Assistance Program (EAP), this offers professional support in all situations, such as assistance with childcare, finding au pairs, and advice on care services- Daycare cooperation for children, holiday childcare and laundry service

Company DescriptionOur Transformation JourneyAs METRO.digital evolves, we are reshaping the way we work through our Target Operating Model (TOM).TOM describes the desired state of our organization’s operational capabilities and functions. It provides a vision for the future state of the business, explaining how the company needs to operate to deliver its strategy and achieve its business goals efficiently. The TOM outlines how various elements like processes, technology, governance, and people should interconnect and interact to deliver value. It serves as a roadmap for implementing organizational change and transformation.About the TeamWe think globally and act locally. Since October 1, our international IT organization has been operating under the new Target Operating Model (TOM). This international IT organization, spanning 21 countries and multiple companies, is the dedicated scope of the International People Strategist. As part of our international People & Culture team, you will establish and embed end-to-end people processes for this IT organization, build trusted relationships with its leaders and local P&C teams, and develop an effective cross-country network. You will connect global frameworks with the specific requirements of the international IT organization and its country organizations, contributing across the full spectrum of People & Culture work, from hands-on operational implementation to strategic initiatives.Beyond day-to-day tasks, our work creates stability, builds trust, and strengthens our culture, enabling our people to thrive and our business to grow.How you will make an impact?As People Strategist for International IT, you are the dedicated P&C Business Partner for our international IT organization, across all METRO countries and companies. Your scope covers the leaders, employees, and organizational units within this international IT organization. You play a key role in embedding the new Target Operating Model by establishing and continuously improving People & Culture processes throughout the employee lifecycle, building trusted relationships, and developing an effective network across the IT organization, its countries, companies, and functions. The role combines hands-on operational work, process ownership, cross-functional coordination, and strategic People & Culture contributions for the international IT organization. Working closely with its leaders, local P&C teams, and Corporate expert functions such as Compensation & Benefits, Recruiting, Talent Development, and Learning, you translate global approaches into practical, consistent, and locally compliant solutions for the IT organization.Job DescriptionYour Responsibilities:- Establish and embed the People & Culture processes, relationships, networks, and ways of working required to make the new Target Operating Model effective within the international IT organization;- Design, establish, implement, and continuously improve People & Culture processes across the entire employee lifecycle for the international IT organization, ensuring clear ownership and effective execution;- Provide hands-on operational support as well as conceptual and strategic People & Culture contributions to the leaders, employees, and organizational units within the international IT organization, depending on business and organizational needs;- Partner with P&C country functions to translate international frameworks into practical solutions for the international IT organization that reflect local business needs, legal requirements, and organizational maturity;- Coordinate closely with Corporate People & Culture expert functions, including Compensation & Benefits, Recruiting, Talent Development, Learning, and other relevant teams, to deliver integrated solutions for the international IT organization;- Support leaders within the international IT organization and their local P&C teams on organizational design, workforce planning, talent, performance, succession, engagement, and employee relations, while enabling appropriate local ownership;- Drive the consistent implementation of global People & Culture frameworks across the international IT organization and facilitate alignment among its countries, companies, functions, and matrix structures;- Use people data, KPIs, and business insights from the international IT organization to identify trends, monitor process effectiveness, assess risks, and derive actionable improvements;- Support organizational change and culture initiatives within the international IT organization and contribute to a consistent employee and manager experience across its countries and companies;- Ensure that People & Culture solutions for the international IT organization comply with applicable labor laws, co-determination requirements, internal policies, and governance standards, in collaboration with the relevant local and Corporate stakeholders.QualificationsRequired key competencies and qualifications:- Degree in Human Resources, Psychology, Business Administration, Law, or a related field;- At least 5 years of relevant HR experience, including several years as an HR Business Partner in an international or matrix organization;- Demonstrated experience advising senior leaders and translating business priorities into pragmatic people solutions;- Strong knowledge of German labor law and employee relations; experience working across additional jurisdictions is an advantage;- Proven capability in organizational design, workforce planning, talent and performance management, and change management;- Confidence working with people data, KPIs, and HRIS/HCM systems to support evidence-based decisions;- Strong business acumen, stakeholder management, consulting, and coaching skills, with the ability to influence across cultures and organizational boundaries;- Pragmatic, solution-oriented, and comfortable navigating ambiguity, competing priorities, and complex change;- Very good fluency in English (written and verbal), German preferred;- Additional languages are an advantage;- Willingness to collaborate across time zones and travel internationally when required.Additional InformationWhat we offer at METRO.digital?- Hybrid and agile work: thrive in a flexible, multicultural environment.At METRO.digital, we promote work-life balance through a hybrid working model. You’ll be part of self-organizing, multicultural teams that collaborate in an agile setup.- People development: when you grow so do we!We want you to become the best version of yourself with individual and company-wide programs and trainings for people development. Focused among other on development, leadership, appreciation ... it´s time to upskill your career.- Support with individual solutions: we are people-caring!We offer support whenever you need it - at every stage of your professional journey.Want to know more about all our benefits? Discover more here (https://metro.digital/about/life-at-metro) .Let´s connect soon. jobs.description: This is a new, dedicated Commercial Sales Manager (m/f/d) position created to provide specialized oversight for the Erfurt factory's generator business. jobs.description: The postdoctoral candidate will work within an international research project focused on improving the performance and long-term stability of aqueous batteries through the development of advanced electrolyte additives.The central objective of the project is to establish an integrated high-throughput workflow combining robotic electrolyte preparation, automated electrochemical testing, and machine-learning-assisted analysis.The work involves extensive experimental laboratory activities, automated testing, electrochemical characterization, data analysis, and close cooperation with industrial project partners. The candidate will contribute to the development of reproducible and data-driven battery research workflows for sustainable, safe, and cost-effective stationary energy-storage technologies.The position is full-time (39 h/week) and fixed-term for 18 months, starting in February 2027.Equal opportunity is an important part of our personnel policy. We would therefore strongly encourage qualified women to apply for the position.Your tasks- Develop and optimize automated high-throughput workflows for the preparation and electrochemical screening of aqueous electrolyte formulations.- Systematically screen a broad range of electrolyte additives and generate high-quality datasets linking electrolyte composition to battery performance.- Perform electrochemical characterization using techniques such as galvanostatic cycling, cyclic voltammetry, and electrochemical impedance spectroscopy.- Analyze large experimental datasets and contribute to the development and validation of machine-learning and quantitative structure-property relationship models.- Publish your results in leading peer-reviewed journals and present them at international conferences, write project reports.- Collaborate closely with researchers, data scientists, and industrial partners working on electrolyte synthesis, battery development, modelling, and scale-up.Your profileRecruitment requirement- A PhD in the subject areas of Materials science, Electrochemistry, Chemical Engineering, Energy Engineering, or similar.Required knowledge and personal skills- Strong background in electrochemistry and aqueous battery technologies.- Hands-on laboratory experience and interest in experimental research.- Experience with electrochemical measurements and data analysis.- Interest in automated experimentation and data-driven materials research.- Ability to work independently and as part of an interdisciplinary research team.- Knowledge of techniques such as EIS, cyclic voltammetry, hydrogen evolution,  and electrode degradation.- Very good English language skills (at least B2/C1 level according to CEFR).Desired knowledge and personal skills- Experience with aqueous batteries, metal-anode batteries, or electrolyte development.- Experience with materials characterization techniques, such as microscopy, X-ray methods.- Experience with automated experimentation, robotics, data science, or machine learning is advantageous.Reach out with your CV and motivation letter expressing your interest and experience in the proposed topic. Got questions before applying? Contact Prof. Zheludkevich (Mikhail.zheludkevich@hereon.de), Dr. Lamaka (Sviatlana.lamaka@hereon.de) or Dr. Snihirova (darya.snihirova@hereon.de).Our offer- Access to state-of-the-art (robotic) labs, unique scientific and technical infrastructure- Access to a large international research and industrial network.- Funding for conferences, summer schools and courses needed or research stays- An exciting job in a research center with around 1,000 employees from more than 60 nations- International Welcome Office with guest accommodation- 6 weeks holiday per year; company holidays between Christmas and New Year's Day- social benefits according to the collective agreement of the public service and remuneration up to EG 13 (according toEntgO Bund)- very good work-life balance; options for mobile and flexible work- A green campus on the Elbe River, well-connected with Hamburg (public transport), subsidy for the Deutschlandticket if certain conditions are met (job ticket), charging facilities for electric vehicles- family-friendly company policy with childcare facilities, e.g. nursery/kindergarten close to the company- Operational Health Management, e.g. Employee Assistance Program (EAP)- Corporate BenefitsSeverely disabled persons and those equaling severely disabled persons who are equally suitable for the position will be considered preferentially within the framework of legal requirements.Interested?
